tooltip.silent_sun.cleaving_pain.1: After placing: use a lava bucket on it to fill it, then right-click to drop in a diamond.
tooltip.silent_sun.cleaving_pain.2: The diamond sinks into the lava and draws a lightning bolt, dropping the Redios Sigil.
tooltip.silent_sun.cleaving_pain.3: Empty the lava, fill it with water, then use the Redios Sigil on the altar to summon Redios.
tooltip.silent_sun.cleaving_pain.4: Requires a diamond pickaxe to harvest; mining drops the block itself so it can be recovered and replaced.
item.silent_sun.redios_sigil.tooltip.1: Use on a water-filled Cleaving Pain altar to summon Shattered Mirror Shadow: Redios.
item.silent_sun.redios_sigil.tooltip.2: Only one Redios may exist per battle. If one is already present, using this teleports you nearby to pursue it. The sigil is never consumed.
message.silent_sun.redios_sigil.busy: Busy. Come back later (%s days remaining)
message.silent_sun.redios_sigil.battle_p: The altar senses an unfinished battle far away — settle it first. (No materials consumed)
message.silent_sun.redios.wall_attack: Wall-piercing throw: walls won't save you.
message.silent_sun.redios.twilight_momen: Twilight Moment: darkness failed; expelled from battle.
message.silent_sun.redios.expelled: You have left the battle and can no longer participate.
message.silent_sun.redios.creative_leave: Tired. I'll go take a nap.
message.silent_sun.redios.weakpoint_hit: You seem to have shown him your resolve...
A rage you've never seen before. Hope you can handle it.
Continue? I think you've trained enough.
message.silent_sun.redios.failsafe: Uh... did I go too far? The world can't handle it. Come back later.
book.silent_sun.redios.defeat.page0: You did well. If you want to stand against the whole world, making the world merely watch you won't be enough.
book.silent_sun.redios.victory.page0: My emergency measures are active. That's enough for today. Had your fill? I know I did.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.0: Between 0 and 1, how far is the distance?
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.1: So close. It should have been within reach.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.2: Wrong after wrong, and not a single true solution.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.3: Now that you've seen it, you can no longer refuse.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.4: As you know. As you wish.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.5: As you feel. As you desire.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.6: You wouldn't think black light could be this blinding.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.7: Let every fallacy burn to ashes.
quote.silent_sun.redios.phase2.9: All that remains is the unrecognizable void of all things.
message.silent_sun.redios.soul_sever_ove: What are you doing... damage is maxed out...
command.silent_sun.redios.reload_configs: Reloaded Redios loot and reward override configs.
Reload encountered errors (falling back to default/empty config).
command.silent_sun.redios.reset_summon_c: Reset Redios summon cooldown and battle ledger.
command.silent_sun.battle_report.on: Battle flow report: ON. The next battle will be recorded (SA casts / title changes / phase settlement / anti-cheat triggers) and written as JSON on exit.
command.silent_sun.battle_report.off: Battle flow report: OFF. An in-progress recording will still be exported when this battle ends; no new ones will start.
message.silent_sun.redios.all_inactive_w: ⚠ All participants are out of the fight (dead / creative / spectator / other dimension): the boss will leave without loot in 10 seconds. Return to survival and back to the arena to cancel.
message.silent_sun.cleaving_pain.fluid_b: It's as if an air wall is blocking you.
message.silent_sun.redios.challenge_succ: That was fun. Sorry if it gave you a headache.
message.silent_sun.redios.anticheat.puni: Cut it out. Let's keep this serious.
message.silent_sun.redios.anticheat.retu: You switched to survival mode. These are your things, take them and go back.
message.silent_sun.redios.anticheat.crea: Come back after you grab your stuff. Hitting me is pointless.
Because of creative-mode interference, I'll leave in 10 minutes.
message.silent_sun.redios.anticheat.deat: What are you doing, haha ouch, you're annoying.
Ugh! There was never really an escape route around here anyway.
message.silent_sun.redios.maxhealth_clam: The attributefix mod isn't installed, so my max health is clamped to 1024 by vanilla (configured %s).
message.silent_sun.redios.hardcore_spare: Next time. Next time you can go all out, no problem. For now, hurry back, rest up, and calm your mind.
message.silent_sun.redios.no_resurrectio: You've given it your all, so I'll go all out too!
message.silent_sun.redios.black_sun_fare: Goodbye, %s, little brother. I probably won't forget you for the rest of my life.
message.silent_sun.redios.anti_exile: Trying to banish me? It won't work.
message.silent_sun.redios.defeat_book_fa: A dirty trick isn't scary, but a dirty trick that fails is.
message.silent_sun.redios.rebuilt_after_: Come! I won't stop until we've fought to our heart's content!
message.silent_sun.redios.dark_star_bedr: The bedrock below has been repaired.
screen.silent_sun.redios.black_sun_defea: Seems your super intelligence, super strength, and super composure are still not quite enough.
Why are you just standing there? Go rest up!
item.silent_sun.redios_disc_phase1.desc: The Pain in Your Eyes · Creator: Moonlit Clear Ice
item.silent_sun.redios_disc_phase2.desc: My Eyes See Only Sorrow · Creator: Moonlit Clear Ice
advancement.silent_sun.root.title: Silent Sun
advancement.silent_sun.teleport_expel.de: Stuck here, neither up nor down.
How can anything be this hard to kill?
advancement.silent_sun.phase2_win.title: Your First Nonlinear Movement
death.attack.redios_attack: Put your back into it! Can't fight with zero effort!
death.attack.redios_attack.item: Put your back into it! Can't fight with zero effort!
death.attack.redios_spectrum: All defenses are meaningless against this blow.
subtitles.silent_sun.redios_summon: Baby, I love you so much
